query_signals_vi: cách; làm sao; hướng dẫn; sao cho
searcher_state: Has a task in front of them and wants to finish it today
page_type_that_wins: Step sequence with the failure modes named, each step showing its own result
proof_examples: Numbered steps in the real order; the mistake that ruins step three; a photo of the halfway state; the tool or quantity used
title_shape: The task plus the constraint the searcher actually has
reflex_to_reject: Opening with company history, or a definition of the thing the searcher is already doing
vn_note: Vietnamese how-to queries very often land on YouTube and TikTok first; a text page that cannot show the halfway state is competing against video and should carry stills
what_it_does_not_establish: Whether the steps work; only that the page states them checkably

query_signals_vi: là gì; nghĩa là gì; khái niệm
searcher_state: Wants one clear answer, then decides whether to read on
page_type_that_wins: Direct answer in the first two sentences with one worked example
proof_examples: A one-sentence definition; a concrete instance with a number in it; the boundary case people get wrong
title_shape: The term itself and nothing else
reflex_to_reject: Padding to length before the answer arrives
vn_note: Vietnamese definition queries are often homework or first-contact research, which means low commercial value and high link value
what_it_does_not_establish: Commercial value; a definition page rarely converts and should not be judged on that

query_signals_vi: so sánh; nên chọn; khác nhau gì; hay hơn
query_signals_en: vs; compare; difference between; which is better
searcher_state: Has a shortlist and wants the deciding difference
page_type_that_wins: Side-by-side table on the axes the buyer actually decides on
proof_examples: The measured difference on each axis; the price of each option today; the case where the other option wins; who each one is wrong for
title_shape: Both named options and the deciding axis
reflex_to_reject: Declaring your own product the winner on every axis
vn_note: Comparison in Vietnam is done heavily in Facebook groups and comment threads; quote those objections verbatim rather than inventing the axes
what_it_does_not_establish: Which option is better for a given reader; the table states differences and the reader weighs them

query_signals_vi: tốt nhất; top; nên mua loại nào
searcher_state: Wants a shortlist assembled by somebody else
page_type_that_wins: Curated list with the selection rule stated, or nothing
proof_examples: The rule used to include and exclude; what was tested and how; price at time of writing; the option to avoid and why
title_shape: A count and the constraint that bounds the list
reflex_to_reject: Entering your own product as the number one entry on a list you wrote
vn_note: These SERPs are held by aggregators and news sites; a brand's own domain rarely wins them, so say so before the work is scoped
what_it_does_not_establish: Whether the brand can rank here at all; usually it cannot and the budget belongs elsewhere

query_signals_vi: mua; đặt hàng; ở đâu bán; chính hãng
searcher_state: Has decided and is looking for a seller to trust
page_type_that_wins: Product or category page with stock and delivery facts visible
proof_examples: Price and what it includes; stock or lead time; the return and warranty terms; the exact variant names
title_shape: The product plus the buying constraint
reflex_to_reject: Marketing narrative above the price and the delivery window
vn_note: Chính hãng is a trust query, not a product query: it is asking whether you are a counterfeiter, so authorised-dealer evidence outranks copy
what_it_does_not_establish: That the buyer trusts you; only that the facts they need are present

query_signals_vi: giá; bao nhiêu tiền; giá bao nhiêu 2026
searcher_state: Wants a number and will leave if there is not one
page_type_that_wins: Page carrying a real figure or a real range with what moves it
proof_examples: The figure or band; what changes it; the date the figure was set
title_shape: The product plus price and the period
reflex_to_reject: Hiding the number behind a form, then ranking for the query
vn_note: Vietnamese price queries carry a year very often; a page with an undated figure reads stale even when it is current
what_it_does_not_establish: Whether the price is competitive; only that it is stated and dated

query_signals_vi: gần đây; ở quận; tại tp hcm; giao tại
query_signals_en: near me; in city; open now
page_type_that_wins: Location page with hours, route and evidence of being open
proof_examples: Address at street level; opening hours including the exception; a photograph of the frontage; the delivery radius
title_shape: The service plus the place name people actually use
reflex_to_reject: A city page written from a template with the district name swapped
vn_note: Most of this query happens in Google Maps rather than in the results page; the Business Profile is the ranking surface and the website supports it
what_it_does_not_establish: Ranking in Maps; the page is one input and proximity dominates

query_signals_vi: bị lỗi; không lên màu; sửa; khắc phục
searcher_state: Something has already gone wrong and they are annoyed
page_type_that_wins: Symptom-first page that names the cause before the fix
proof_examples: The symptom in the words the user would type; the cause; the fix; when the fix will not work
reflex_to_reject: Answering the symptom the product does not actually cause
vn_note: These queries surface in Zalo and Facebook support threads first; the page's job is often to be what support pastes
what_it_does_not_establish: Whether the product caused it; the page separates causes it can and cannot own

query_signals_vi: tên thương hiệu; có tốt không; review
searcher_state: Already knows the name and is checking it out
page_type_that_wins: Home or about page plus whatever review surface exists
proof_examples: Who runs it with a real name; how long and where; a verifiable customer or partner
title_shape: The brand name plus what it does
reflex_to_reject: Optimising a brand query for keywords the brand does not own
vn_note: Có tốt không attached to a brand name is a scam check; the honest answer is registration details and a traceable address, not testimonials
what_it_does_not_establish: Reputation; the page states verifiable facts and reputation is decided elsewhere

searcher_state: Has an occasion and a deadline before it
page_type_that_wins: Occasion page with the cut-off date and the fulfilment promise
proof_examples: The order cut-off date; the delivery window; the price for the occasion bundle; last year's photograph of the real thing
reflex_to_reject: Publishing the occasion page after the searches have peaked
vn_note: Vietnamese occasion demand front-loads by two to four weeks and dies overnight; a Tết page live in late January is late
what_it_does_not_establish: Demand size; the calendar is known and the volume is not
